headline: Doubao to pull agent features ahead of China's companion rules
body: A quiet day. ByteDance's Doubao, with 345 million monthly users, said it will remove agent features when China's rules on human-like AI services take effect, a slight pullback in AI Autonomy and a nudge to Surveillance. Other lines drifted as earlier stories faded. Horizon Balance: +2.04.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Protector God -0.07, from fading earlier news (-0.05) and Doubao pulling agent features (-0.02); Descendants -0.07, from fading earlier news (-0.05) and Doubao pulling agent features (-0.02).
coming_up: China's interim measures on anthropomorphic AI services take effect July 15; Doubao removes agent features that day
